facts.fact: Ordonnance n°2012-016/P-RM of 19 March 2012 creates the Agence Malienne de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité (AMANORM) as a public administrative body with legal personality and financial autonomy, charged with implementing national policy on standardisation and quality promotion and with creating and managing the national conformity mark; it names no national standard on information technology or data.

systems.country_label: Agence Malienne de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité
systems.owner: State (public administrative body, under the minister of industry, investment and trade)

note: Standards body created by ordinance; the ordinance names no IT or data standard and no certification against one (its certification and conformity-mark duties are general), so no fact on published or certification.
